data.note: moves are in PERCENT. Announcement dates come from SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filings ("Results of Operations and Financial Condition") — the primary source, dated to the day, and each reaction carries the accession number that dated it. EDGAR records a filing DATE and not a time, so whether a release landed before the open or after the close is NOT knowable; each reaction is therefore measured from the session BEFORE the announcement to the session AFTER it, a window that contains the move under either timing. gap_percent is prior close to reaction open, move_percent is close-to-close, intraday_percent is the reaction session's own open-to-close. EPS/surprise is matched from the upstream history by fiscal period and is omitted when it cannot be matched — a price move with no EPS beats the wrong quarter's EPS.
